item.title: 7 Signs You Have Rejection Sensitivity Dysphoria (RSD)
item.description: Rejection sensitivity dysphoria (RSD) is the experience of severe emotional pain and distress related to feelings of failure and rejection. RSD is linked to attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) as well as depression and anxiety.
